snippet.title: UNKNOWN FACES - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
A 6–15 player Mafia-style social-deduction game set in a dark underground interrogation room. Discuss, accuse, investigate, and vote to uncover the Mafia before they take control.

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3494630/UNKNOWN_FACES
